rows.what: Added producer quarantine to the AttentionRouter: a bounded per-producer record of wasted attention (repeats, shed) gives a reputation in bp, and a producer under the floor after min_signals, or whose ModelReputation::overall_bp is under it, gets Disposition::Quarantined (no wake, no budget, no hold slot) until release_producer. Floor and minimum are required constructor arguments; no figure is chosen.

Nothing yet feeds ModelReputation into report_model_reputation. No serving deployment is committed.
